name: Whiteboard Idea to Launch
summary: A hand sketches doodle icons of a lightbulb, a laptop and a rocket joined by arrows, each labelled.
bestFor: Showing a journey from idea to product launch in three steps
prompt: Show how a product goes from idea to launch on a whiteboard. A hand draws a lightbulb and labels it Idea, then an arrow to a simple laptop labelled Build, then an arrow to a rocket labelled Launch. Add a short voiceover for each step, explaining what happens at that stage in plain, friendly language.
